card.title: Dawn Shift
card.instruments: acoustic guitar, warm bass, live drums
card.lyrics:
[verse]
I left the porch light on for you
The road was long and the sky was blue
I counted every mile back home
[chorus]
Oh the morning is on our side
We were never going to hide
Take the long way take it slow
The morning is on our side
